testcase.name: Scenario: Dock the model browser on the opposite side: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:741:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dock the model browser on the opposite side ✔ Given a part is open in the MCAD Software with the model browser docked on the left ✔ When the user drags the Model tab to the right edge and release it ✔ Then the browser docks on the right of the viewport ✔ And its tree remains visible ✔ And the shaded block remains visible with the same apparent orientation ✔ When the user drags the Model tab to the left edge and release it ✔ Then the browser docks on the left again ✔ And the tree and shaded block remain visible
